разобраться.gloss: to sort out, to figure out

meanings.en: to sort out, to settle, to deal with
meanings.note: мы сами разберёмся = we'll sort it out ourselves

В + prepositional. Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'обраться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sort out, to figure out', paired with 'разбираться'.
